a.lede: NVIDIA's board chair said it doesn't want Jensen Huang back in the CEO role during the company's first earnings call since his resignation.
a.title: NVIDIA's board chair says the company is not considering reinstating Jensen Huang as CEO

b.lede: Interim CEO Collete Kress reportedly offered staffers higher wages and more equity on an advanced schedule at the company's first all-hands after Jensen Huang resigned.
b.title: Nvidia promises employee pay raises, equity before December to quell unrest in wake of Jensen Huang scandal
